critic.text: via VIN at (21.75, 5.00) is 0.00 mm from U2.1 (keep 0.2 mm of track between them)
critic.hint: move the via off the pad, or route a short neck to it
critic.why: A via right against a pad of its own net drinks the pad's solder in reflow: the joint starves and a small part can tombstone. A short neck of track between them keeps the solder on the pad.

critic.text: no room on the silkscreen for C2: left on the assembly layer
critic.hint: move the part (or its neighbours) to leave a label's height clear beside it; autoplace keeps that room for the parts it places
critic.why: An assembler and anyone debugging the board find a part by the reference printed beside it; one left off the silkscreen has to be looked up in the drawings.
Mounting holes hold the board without stressing solder joints; they are easiest to plan before parts crowd the corners.
